pitfalls: No LiteRT-LM release runs this file: from PyPI, LiteRT-LM 0.19.1 stops on the CPU with `moe node #85 unsupported activation='silu'` and on the GPU with `moe only supports activation='gelu_tanh' (or its legacy spelling 'gelu')`. SiLU in the moe op is in the LiteRT pull requests #11192 (GPU kernel) and #11188 (XNNPACK kernel, CPU), open on 2026-11-09; the card's numbers come from a LiteRT-LM built from source with both (card L25, L79-L99).

On a LiteRT-LM built from source with #11192 and #11188 (not a release), the card measured this file on an Apple M4 Max (128 GB, macOS 27.0) with WebGPU, 1,024 prefill and 256 decode tokens, 2026-11-09: prefill 1,038.14 tok/s, decode 54.95 tok/s, peak physical footprint 32.64 GB; on its 12 check questions and a 3-turn conversation, the same verdict as Transformers 12 / 12, the stop token 12 / 12, 3 turns pass; the KV cache holds 2,048 tokens (card L21, L34, L52-L54, L65-L69).

Keep the fp32 activation declaration: copies of the files that declare fp16 decoded 9 to 17 % faster, but no reply on WebGPU had an answer (empty, a single `*` before the stop token, or a short pattern repeated over the whole reply) (card L21, L41).

The card's GPU numbers and checks used --sampler_handles_input=false; without it, two runs of the four code questions gave the same verdicts but not the same text. The Python, Kotlin and Swift APIs of LiteRT-LM 0.19.1 have no setting for it (card L113).

Tool calls are XML (<tool_call>, <function=…>, <parameter=…>), declared through generic_model's tool_call_config; the card compared the calls' text with Transformers by giving the CLI the template's text as is (no template applied) and did not run the runtime's own parsing of a call (card L44).
The sampler is TOP_P (top_p 0.8, top_k 20, temperature 0.7); the source's repetition_penalty of 1.05 is not in the file (LiteRT-LM's metadata has no field for it) (card L45).
Size: 20.65 GB; no phone was tried (card L31, L61).
